newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Mutual has unrealised losses on securities.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Mutual has unrealised losses on securities.

text.p: Tokyo Mutual Life Insurance Co, a medium-sized Japanese life insurer, said on Tuesday that it had 6.49 billion yen in unrealised losses on its securities holdings at the end of March compared with 35.34 billion yen in unrealised profits a year earlier.
The company said in a statement that the securities include domestic bonds, stocks and foreign securities.
As for shareholdings, it said that it had 675 million yen of unrealised profits on its shareholdings at the end of March, down sharply from 45.82 billion yen a year earlier.
